description: 侧边栏工作区树:按官方磁盘目录嵌套(官方 workspace-tree 语义),可选按名称中的 / 分组(默认关闭,设置里开启);工作区可手动归入项目组(存储驱动、不改标题、可多级嵌套);新会话页的工作区选择器同树;资源管理器右键可把目录「作为工作区打开」(仅 Windows,宿主半收件箱+注册表,不改客户端)。Workspace tree for the DSH sidebar: disk-path nesting (official workspace-tree semantics), with optional "/"-name grouping (off by default); workspaces can be binned into manual project groups (store-driven, title-preserving, nestable); the same tree in the New Session workspace picker; Explorer right-click can open a folder as a workspace (Windows only: host-half inbox + registry, zero client changes).
